articles.author: Yiren Digital Ltd.
articles.headline: Yiren Digital Provides Update on Its CEO and Operations
articles.summary: Yiren says it learned of a police notice concerning criminal compulsory measures involving CEO Ning Tang and affiliates of its controlling shareholder. It says it received no official notice, cannot assess the investigation's outcome, and continues normal operations. The investigation is reported, not a finding of guilt.
articles.timestampEvidence: Original PR Newswire header explicitly gives October 12, 2026 17:00 ET.

articles.author: Yiren Digital Ltd.
articles.headline: Yiren Digital Appoints Na Mei as Acting Chief Executive Officer
articles.summary: The board appoints former CFO Na Mei as acting CEO effective October 13 to support management continuity following its October 12 CEO update. This is a separately published update on the same management situation.
articles.timestampEvidence: Original PR Newswire header explicitly gives October 13, 2026 08:00 ET.

articles.author: Yiren Digital Ltd.
articles.headline: Yiren Digital Provides Further Update on Operations
articles.summary: Yiren states that the investigation concerns activities outside its operations, emphasizes operational independence, discusses previously disclosed related-party credit-loss provisions and reaffirms its existing repurchase program. These are issuer statements, not independent confirmation that there will be no financial impact.
articles.timestampEvidence: Original PR Newswire header explicitly gives October 14, 2026 06:00 ET.
